jobs.occupation: ESG & Impact Officer - International Exposure - Brussels
jobs.description:
The hiring company is a medium-sized organization within the financial services sector, specializing in banking and financial services. It is known for its focus on innovation, sustainability, and delivering impactful solutions for its stakeholders

Jobomschrijving

As an ESG & Impact Officer your responsibilities are:

• Conduct ESG and impact due diligence for high-risk investments
• Assess projects across sectors such as infrastructure, mining, agriculture, forestry, and financial services
• Manage external ESG and environmental & social consultants
• Support portfolio companies in implementing ESG management systems and action plans
• Monitor ESG performance and impact outcomes throughout the investment lifecycle
• Strengthen ESG policies, frameworks, tools, and internal processes
• Contribute to impact reporting, case studies, and stakeholder communications
• Coordinate third-party ESG and impact assessments
• Represent the organization at industry events and ESG-related initiatives

A successful ESG & Impact Officer should have:

• Master's degree in Economics, International Development, Political Science, Environmental Sciences, or a related discipline
• Strong experience applying IFC Performance Standards
• Direct contacts with companies
• Exposure to projects in emerging and developing markets
• Solid knowledge of ESG risk assessment methodologies
• Experience reviewing Environmental & Social Management Systems (ESMS)
• Understanding of impact measurement frameworks, SDGs, Theory of Change, or similar approaches
• Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; Power BI experience is a plus
• Ability to draft high-quality analytical reports and investment documentation in English

Our client is an international organisation headquartered in Brussels, bringing together members and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a fast-paced and multicultural environment, the organisation is seeking an Administration Officer to support its administrative, financial and office management activities and help ensure the efficient running of its operations.

Jobomschrijving

• Process invoices and maintain accurate supplier and financial records.
• Support payment processing, budget tracking and expense administration.

A successful Project Officer should have:

• Strong organisational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Confident user of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
• Able to prioritise workloads, manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
• Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented approach to work.
• Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a range of internal and external stakeholders.

Our client is a leading international insurance company with a strong presence in the Belgian market. Through innovation, customer-centricity, and operational excellence, the organization continuously invests in transforming and growing their Business Units.To support the successful execution of its strategic ambitions, our client is currently looking for a Strategic Change Analyst to join its Brussels-based office.

Jobomschrijving

• Support the definition, structuring and monitoring of the Business Unit strategic roadmap
• Translate strategic priorities into compelling communication materials, executive presentations and impactful storytelling
• Prepare presentations, reports and strategic updates for senior management and executive committees
• Conduct business and strategic analyses to support decision-making and identify growth opportunities

• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in strategy, consulting, business analysis, project management, transformation or change management
• Strong understanding of the Life Insurance sector, including products, regulations and market dynamics
• Experience supporting strategic planning, business transformation and roadmap execution
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations
• Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, financial analysis and management reporting
• Proven ability to create impactful presentations and deliver effective executive-level storytelling
• Experience in process improvement and cross-functional project coordination
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across multiple business functions
• Highly organized, autonomous and capable of challenging assumptions in a constructive manner
• Ability to synthesize complex information and present clear conclusions to management
• Fluency in French/Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

jobs.occupation: Finance Officer – Financial Control, Reporting & Process Improvement
jobs.description:
As a Finance Officer, you join the Administration Division of an international intergovernmental organisation promoting free trade and economic integration. You take hands-on responsibility for financial control and reporting while leading initiatives to improve administrative and financial processes.
 

You report directly to the Head of Finance and work within a four-person finance team. The department manages the organisation’s finances across offices in Brussels, Luxembourg and Geneva, as well as its Financial Mechanism Office.
 

This position is exclusively open to nationals of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland. The starting date is as soon as possible and no later than 1 March 2027. The application deadline is 18 October 2026.
 

Je verantwoordelijkheden:
 
 

• Preparing financial reports and analyses. 

• Performing accounting controls. 

• Coordinating the year-end closing process. 

• Managing projects to improve business processes within the Administration Division. 

• Overseeing procurement activities. 

• Overseeing contract management. 

• Overseeing travel management. 

• Acting as Head of Finance when required. 
 

• Nationality of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway or Switzerland is an essential eligibility requirement. 

• A master’s degree in business administration, finance, accounting or another relevant field is required. 

• At least five years of relevant experience in financial management, accounting, controlling, audit and/or consulting provides the necessary professional foundation. 

• A solid understanding of accounting, controlling and reporting is essential. 

• Practical experience with at least one accounting software package is required. 

• Excellent command of MS Excel supports your daily work. 

• Fluency in written and spoken English is essential. 

• A structured and analytical mindset characterises your approach. 

• Strong interpersonal skills allow you to collaborate effectively with colleagues. 

• You demonstrate commitment, motivation and initiative. 

• At least two years of consulting experience is an advantage. 

• Experience with payroll and public procurement would be an asset. 

• Knowledge of MS Dynamics 365 Finance and Power BI, including Power Query and Power Pivot, offers added value. 

• Experience as an IT systems superuser and/or with systems implementation is an advantage. 

• Project management experience and the ability to lead business improvement processes are valuable. 

• Previous work in an international environment is a plus. 

• Self-reliance, autonomy and a proactive approach complete your profile.

Jobomschrijving

Key Responsibilities

• Participate in purchasing and commercial projects with a focus on value creation and business performance.
• Coordinate and facilitate discussions between various stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
• Support negotiations, prepare relevant documentation and follow up on agreed actions.
• Analyse data and market insights to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.

Successful Candidate Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Procurement, Supply Chain, Marketing, or a related field.
• 2-5 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, FMCG, retail, category management, account management, commercial, or project management roles.
• Strong business acumen with an interest in purchasing, negotiations, and strategic stakeholder management.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build credibility and manage multiple stakeholders.
• Advanced Excel skills and a data-driven mindset.
• Pragmatic, proactive, relationship-oriented, and comfortable operating in an international environment.
• Fluent in French and English; additional languages such as Dutch or German are a plus.

Jobomschrijving

• Keep freight shipments moving smoothly and on schedule

• Monitor and follow up on shipments from start to finish

jobs.occupation: Strategic Pricing and Tender Management Specialist - Medtech
jobs.description:
Our client is an international healthcare business experiencing strong growth across global markets. The organization combines entrepreneurial agility with the resources and career opportunities of a multinational environment.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Medical Devices - Pricing Strategy & Tender Management Specialist - UK & Ireland, your responsibilities are:

• Lead end-to-end tender management processes across the UK & Ireland markets
• Manage Tenders submission with local Authorities from UK & Ireland (NHS & HSE)

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives within pricing processes
• Collaborate with EMEA and US stakeholders on strategic projects

As a successful Medical Devices - Pricing Strategy & Tender Management Specialist - UK & Ireland, you should have:

• 5  years of experience in Pricing and/or Tender Management
• Background within Healthcare, MedTech, Medical Devices, or Pharma
• Experience managing complex tenders and commercial contracts
• Experiences with UK authorities (NHS & HSE) is highly preferred
• Strong financial and analytical capabilities
• Advanced Excel skills; SAP experience is highly desirable
• Fluent English communication skills
• Strong stakeholder management and project coordination abilities
• Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to perform in a fast-paced environment

Our client is a well-established international organization operating within a complex retail and logistics environment. Technology plays a central role in supporting business operations, and the company is investing in delivering a high-quality IT support experience to its internal users.The position is based in the Dilbeek area.

As an IT Service Desk Support Specialist, your responsibilities will include:

• Acting as the first point of contact for IT incidents and service requests.
• Logging, categorizing, prioritizing, and managing tickets through the ITSM platform.

• Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel)
• Windows environments and first-level troubleshooting
• Active Directory and user administration
• Networking and connectivity fundamentals
• End-user hardware and peripherals
• Mobile device support
• Strong customer service and communication skills.
• Excellent organizational skills with a structured approach to ticket management.
• Analytical problem-solving capabilities and the ability to prioritize effectively.
• A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a genuine desire to develop technical skills further.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to develop business across the Middle East and Africa.Our client is an international wholesaler of industrial sealing solutions, supplying technical distributors and industrial trading partners. Its product range includes O-rings, industrial seals and customised sealing products for a wide variety of applications.The company is looking for a commercially driven professional who enjoys approaching potential customers, developing new accounts and turning opportunities into actual sales.This position has a strong business development focus. You will work closely with the External Sales Representative to expand the customer portfolio across the MEA region while continuing to develop relationships with existing clients.What will you do? 
• Actively identify and approach potential B2B customers across the Middle East and Africa. 
• Prospect for new business opportunities and open new customer accounts. 
• Follow up on commercial leads and convert opportunities into sales. 
• Build relationships with new customers and develop long-term business opportunities. 
• Maintain and expand existing customer accounts. 
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling. 
• Prepare quotations and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process orders and respond to customer enquiries. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Understand customer requirements and propose suitable sealing solutions. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative on commercial activities and customer development. 
• Monitor sales opportunities and report on commercial progress. 
• Provide professional customer service and ensure timely follow-up of requests.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have experience in B2B sales and/or customer service. 
• You genuinely enjoy prospecting and approaching new customers. 
• You are confident initiating commercial conversations and following up on opportunities. 
• You are fluent in English and French, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage, but not a requirement. 
• Experience with customers in the Middle East or Africa is a plus. 
• Experience selling technical or industrial products is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general business software. 
• You communicate clearly and know how to build professional relationships. 
• You take initiative and are motivated by commercial results. 
• You can work independently while maintaining close contact with your sales colleagues. 
• You are customer-oriented, persistent and organised in your approach.

The company supplies technical distributors and industrial trading partners worldwide.You will join a small, internationally oriented sales team where customer relationships, technical understanding and commercial initiative are equally important.Your focus will be on managing existing accounts while identifying opportunities to develop new business. Approximately 70% of your activities will involve existing customers, with the remaining 30% focused on new customer acquisition.What will you do? 
• Manage and develop relationships with existing B2B customers. 
• Identify potential customers and open new accounts. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative to develop sales opportunities. 
• Prepare quotations, calculate prices and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process customer orders and monitor their progress. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Identify cross-selling opportunities within the existing product range. 
• Encourage customers to use the company's digital ordering tools. 
• Handle customer enquiries, complaints and commercial requests. 
• Keep customer information accurate and up to date in the internal system.

• Monitor commercial opportunities and report on sales activities. 
• Support colleagues when needed and contribute to the daily operation of the sales department.

• You have at least 4 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably involving technical products. 
• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong advantage. 
• Knowledge of French and/or Arabic is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and other business software. 
• You enjoy maintaining customer relationships and identifying commercial opportunities. 
• You communicate clearly and confidently with international customers. 
• You are organised and capable of managing several customer requests simultaneously. 
• You take initiative and follow up on commercial opportunities without needing constant supervision. 
• You work well in a small team and remain focused when priorities change. 
• An interest in industrial products and technical applications will help you succeed in this role.
